scope421.potential_impact_if_each_reclassified_wi: Up to 421 additional Masters pass the current map helper; no scope change is authorized by this report.

conflicts55.root_cause: Confirmed non-containment between governorate and parent-region geometry in the retained combined reference. Available evidence cannot identify which of the two source layers is spatially wrong.

outside15.assessment: Do not accept all 15 as genuinely outside Saudi. 12 intersect current Taadeen Governorate 511 (Al Udayd) geometry although none intersects a region polygon; 3 intersect no governorate or region polygon.

eligible5.assessment: Five false-positive candidates in the Al-Ahsa Governorate 501 filtered map; live geometry locates them in Governorate 511, Al Udayd, while their parent Eastern Region polygon contains them.

classifications.confirmed_geographic_position: Direct Master/Furas coordinates align for all 421 scope records; current live polygon queries confirm the 5 eligible points fall in Gov 511 and 12 outside-boundary records fall in Gov 511.

proposed_corrections.recommendation: Request an authoritative GEOSA versioned region/governorate geometry package, parent IDs, CRS/datum transformation details, release/effective date, and applicable reuse license; replace neither existing geometry nor production data in this task.
Review existing direct point evidence against the existing single-point scope rule; only an approved, auditable per-record decision may change UNSPECIFIED.
Candidate reassignment away from Governorate 501 to 511 (Al Udayd), conditional on authoritative dataset acceptance and source-owner review.
Resolve governorate/region polygon containment before elevating outside-region provenance to verified.
Keep outside-Saudi review and require manual authoritative boundary adjudication; do not fabricate coordinates.

expected_impact.note: Conditional effects only; no target map count is set. The reconciliation count 518 remains the measured state.
